text:
Maya: Heads up - noticing a 46% drop in active API queries from ElmCo over the past 10 days. Seats still provisioned, but activity is way down. Billing hasn't changed yet. @Priya did they flag a procurement review on last week's call?
Priya: they hinted at a budget review, yeah. PM there (Lena) said they're evaluating latency and total cost vs. one of the big cloud vendor managed endpoints. No formal RFP yet.
Jonah: thanks. Any signal on whether it's noise from their new release or an actual shift?
Maya: query lengths look normal but peak concurrency down. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/example/elmco - last successful daily tokens: 120k -> 65k.
Diego: I pulled infra logs, no errors on our side. Their integration logs show fewer calls initiated from their connector service starting 2025-06-07.
Priya: Lena told me procurement asked for a cost breakdown and a 2-week performance trial from competitor. They're not signed off for a full migration yet.
Katie: flagging renewal watch. Next renewal in 90 days. We should treat this as an early warning.
Maya: proposed plan: 1) Offer a 2-week performance-run with dedicated tuning (no cost). 2) Prepare a one-pager ROI + latency comparisons tailored to their workload. 3) Schedule a short EBR with exec sponsor and procurement. Thoughts?
Jonah: +1. Also offer a short workshop with our SE team to optimize batching/kv-cache for their normal flows. That usually moves the needle.
Diego: I can do a quick config audit. If they share a sampling of request traces (anonymized) I can point to concrete perf gains. Example ask: "send 1-2 days of logs or sanitized request dump".
Priya: I can ask Lena to share traces; she'll need an NDA addendum for logs. Sales side ok with that?
Jonah: yes, we can put a narrow NDA addendum. I'll draft language.
Maya: timeline: ask for traces today; SE audit in 48h; ROI deck by EOD Friday; EBR scheduling for next week. Anyone blocked?
Katie: I'll join the EBR and bring procurement playbook. Also propose offering 10% credit extension during trial to reduce churn risk.
Priya: procurement said pricing comparison was the main ask. Can we produce side-by-side cost per 1M tokens for their common prompt lengths across our 2 suggested configurations?
Diego: yes - I'll produce cost/latency pairs for default and cached configurations.
Maya: cool. I'll message Lena right after this thread. @ops-bot can you create a renewal-watch ticket with priority=high and link to this thread?
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-7129: ElmCo renewal-watch (priority: high) - https://redwood.atlassian/CS-7129 :white_check_mark:
Jonah: small ask - let's avoid a full price war. Highlight reliability, rollout controls, and our canary/fallback story.
Maya: agreed. Emphasize migration risk and operational cost. I'll share a short script for the EBR to keep it tight.
Priya: I'll coordinate NDA addendum and confirm stakeholders (Lena, their CTO, procurement lead).
Diego: sending preliminary audit checklist in 30m.
Maya: thanks team. I'll update ticket with next steps after I hear from Lena. :thumbsup:
